digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration and parity measurement
propositions: Bedrock must pass the same non-inferiority bar (structured-output validity, zero decision-level flips, recall and false-accept within tolerance, runtime error rate, gold-coverage floor) that was required before the last LLM substrate swap

A paired-corpus harness must be built to measure Bedrock parity, modeled on the landed fidelity_spot_eval precedent, running the same cases through both direct-Anthropic and Bedrock arms with only the model differing

The operator scope ruling redefines S6 success criteria from verdict equivalence (two different models must decide alike) to payload and tool parity (the same payloads and tools reach both providers), making non-determinism between models expected and out of scope
Payload parity and tool parity must be proven by captured outbound requests at the provider boundary, not by code inspection, with all eight legitimate envelope differences enumerated

Bedrock inference-profile invokability must be confirmed per slot in account 896586841071 / us-east-1 before corpus spend, and temperature capability differences must be handled explicitly via the supports_temperature override mechanism
